info.background_text:
The dangerous femme fatale who lures those around her to ruin
Commander of the infamous mercenary group, the Black Spica. With her alluring beauty and eloquent speech, she captivates others and toys with them as if they were mere playthings. Your instincts tell you to stay away, yet she possesses an irresistible allure that no one can look away from.
